architecture_summary: Modular React app. Design system components in src/components/. Pages in src/pages/. Router use React Router. CSS use Tailwind. State local first, context for global (auth, theme). No Redux. No SSR. Static assets in public/.

tickets.title: Design system foundation - button, badge, card components
tickets.description: Extract button, badge, card from Stitch screens. Build reusable components in src/components/. Use Tailwind for styling. Support all variants (size, color, state) shown in screens. Export as named exports from index.js in each component dir.
acceptance_criteria: Components render without errors in Storybook

tickets.title: Design system - input, toast, loader components
tickets.description: Build input, toast, loader components. Input support text, password, select, checkbox, radio. Toast support success, error, warning, info. Loader support spinner, skeleton. Use Tailwind. Export from src/components/Input/, src/components/Toast/, src/components/Loader/.
acceptance_criteria: Toast auto-dismiss after 5s, manual dismiss work

tickets.title: Design system - tab, table components
tickets.description: Build tab, table components. Tab support horizontal, vertical, controlled, uncontrolled. Table support sorting, pagination, row selection. Use Tailwind. Export from src/components/Tabs/, src/components/Table/.
acceptance_criteria: Table sorting work on click headers

tickets.title: Feature highlights page (src/pages/FeatureHighlights.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen to React page. Use design system components. Layout match screen. Responsive. Data hardcoded for now. Later fetch from API.

tickets.title: Playful bento showcase page (src/pages/BentoShowcase.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch bento screen to React page. Use design system components. Layout match screen. Responsive. Data hardcoded. Later fetch from CMS.

tickets.title: 404 error pages (src/pages/errors/404MysteryPuzzle.jsx, 404JungleTrail.jsx, 404CosmicDetour.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert 3 Stitch 404 screens to React pages. Use design system components. Layout match screens. Responsive. Rotate pages via router config later.

tickets.title: Design system storybook setup (src/stories/) and documentation
tickets.description: Setup Storybook. Add stories for all design system components. Document props, variants, usage. Use CSF format. Stories match Stitch screens.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Build app shell. Add navigation bar. Setup React Router. Routes for all pages. 404 route rotate between 3 error pages. Lazy-load pages. Error boundaries. Global styles. Favicon. Meta tags.
